order_item_quantity_ck.name: order_item_quantity_ck
order_item_quantity_ck.value:
("order_item"."event_seat_id" IS NOT NULL AND "order_item"."quantity" = 1)
          OR ("order_item"."allocation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "order_item"."quantity" >= 1)

ticket_event_seat_id_live_uq.name: ticket_event_seat_id_live_uq
ticket_event_seat_id_live_uq.where: "ticket"."event_seat_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket"."deleted_at" IS NULL

audit_log_action_data_ck.name: audit_log_action_data_ck
audit_log_action_data_ck.value:
("audit_log"."action" = 'INSERT' AND "audit_log"."old_data" IS NULL AND "audit_log"."new_data" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("audit_log"."action" = 'UPDATE' AND "audit_log"."old_data" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."new_data" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("audit_log"."action" = 'DELETE' AND "audit_log"."old_data" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."new_data" IS NULL)
